Altar Boys Society Church of the Sacred Heart
Writing not of Fr. Solanus! Describes the rules and
dues for the members of the Altar Boys Society.

1911
Page 4 Here begins the notes of Father Solanus Casey in his hand. IN NOMINE JESU INCIPIT A. D. 1911
January 1st No server for 7 o'cl Mass (F. McCreedy failed to noti- fy F. Keegan (C. Hefferman, not well.
Jan. 1st Two baby funerals and Tho's Reiley One of the two a little Kellog Girl at whose funeral services on Wearing Pl. Many protestants-including her Father seemed quite impressed. Some of the prayes were repeated in English and Fr. Solanus gave a little instruction B. Landy, and Jos. Fitzpatrick served.
Jan. 3rd At 8 o'cl services G. Gorman spilled burning censer on carpet
Jan. 6th Epiphany, 1st Friday F. McCreedy's turn to take censer - not present J. Fitzpatrick takes his place after serv- ing 7 o'cl Mass. Today Rev. Ed. Everitt (Minister) join- ed League of Sacred Heart.
Jan. 7th Prizes promissed - gold and silver medals, etc. for faith- ful boys. - c punch following Sat.
Jan. 15th 21st Fr. McCreedy and G. Gorman served 7 o'cl Mass and Rev Fr. Kimrey's- near 7:30
Jan. 20th Funeral of Samuel Hinchcliff (Fr. Solanus neglected to in- tone "In paradiso" no Benedictus
